name: Battle 6 — Cassewick Again
briefing: The Weirgate broke Vare's host, and Halgate marched north to take back what the raid stole. Cassewick still flies Vare colours — a thin garrison on the burned granary, Distress among them, the raider that won the town.
You will reach it before they can reinforce it. But not by much: a relief column is already riding hard from the east, and whoever holds the yard when it is done keeps the town.
You sent the Charter Company, rebuilt around its bows. Take the yard fast, off the garrison, and hold it three rounds through whatever the relief throws at it.
This is your offensive. Slowness is the enemy now, not the friend it was on the causeway.
